description: Search the public Runx skill catalog and inspect skill source and requirements through its read-only hosted discovery MCP.

notes: Hosted discovery is public and read-only. Running a skill requires the separate local Runx runtime, explicit authority, and receipts.
The maintained plugin README documents the hosted endpoint, two discovery tools, and separate local execution.
The plugin’s 512px logo matches the current Mechanism symbol served on runx.ai.
